posts.cooked: Please try without tmux. Looks like it has reached maximum limit of open processes for your account. If you have too many previous sessions open then kill them from the ssh website.

posts.name: Rajesh
posts.cooked:
I tried without tmux and killed previous processes but still “fork: Resource temporarily unavailable” error occurs. one time its worked with previously submitted BPT1, but after that error occurs repeatedly. Still my BPT 4 Problem 4 submission is pending so pls check it out.

I tried to debug with AI and this is the result:

  • The error was observed running shell commands in your VM’s terminal, which showed ulimit -u 50 (a low user process cap) and process errors.​

  • Your VM reported plenty of free memory and swap, but was still unable to fork processes due to hitting the process limit—this is almost always an OS/user configuration and much more common in virtualized or restricted containers, not on modern macOS systems.

posts.name: Rajesh
posts.cooked: Thank you sir, I didn’t kill the previous process properly. Out 50 I reached 48, now I properly killed it and it’s working fine.
